independent_reference.ideal_and_quantization: Separate ideal signed B*rho_w*alpha*ki/gamma_ref*(GJ dot g), then quantization correction=complete actual-float delta reference minus ideal. Both signs and every512 native node are exported, not only maxima.
independent_reference.q_difference: Optional CSV XYZ deltaq=-ki*rho_w/gamma_ref*deltaAi is a DERIVED conditional Darcy diagnostic, not a saved native production q, not an independently assembled production flux-divergence or new q acceptance gate.

If actual saved endpoint does not resolve it, retain failure; do not tune J,Ck,g,p or extend/rerun the trajectory.
